provider-plugin.title: fspec Provider Plugin for Paseo
provider-plugin.description: A Paseo provider plugin that registers an "fspec" provider and acts as a real client of a running fspec daemon over the fspec RPC protocol (bincode-encoded tarpc messages in WebSocket envelope frames). No second agent loop, no polling, no fspec subprocess - only contract translation plus connection lifecycle.

kanban-board.title: fspec Kanban board in Paseo
kanban-board.description: A native Paseo workspace panel (desktop + mobile) that mirrors the fspec board: live columns from the daemon's WorkUnitsUpdate push, card details, in-column reorder and open-in-agent. Parity with the fspec TUI board only - no status changes, no card editing, no fspec daemon changes.

provider-settings.title: fspec provider settings in Paseo
provider-settings.description: Manage fspec's model providers from Paseo, like the fspec TUI's /provider view: credentials (API key, OAuth, custom endpoint), connection tests, model-cache refresh, default model, local-server profiles and custom models. Changes refresh Paseo's fspec model picker. Every write goes through the daemon RPCs the TUI already uses; nothing is reimplemented.
